# From one cheaper forward pass to an auditable long-term research loop

[简体中文](../../../../learning/deep-dives/recommendation/research-serving-loop.md) · English

Updated 2026-10-27 · 19 topic entries / 5 representative comparisons

ROCS removes duplicate computation within a request. Rec-Distill moves expensive teacher knowledge into training. Effective Training Time tracks training lifecycle losses. FORTE controls feature retirement risk. Self-Evolving RecSys links proposals, experiments, and online feedback over time. They optimize different timescales; lower GPU cost, feature removal, and automated proposals are not evidence of recommendation gains.

[Mechanisms](#comparison) · [Trade-offs](#analysis) · [Cross-paper questions](#questions) · [Updates](#updates)

## Trade-off analysis {#analysis}

### Charge costs to the right stage

ROCS shares user encoding across candidates in one request, saving online duplicate work. Rec-Distill moves the larger model's influence into training and deploys a lightweight main tower, which may increase training work. ETT measures the share of end-to-end training advancing on new data, not request latency or device utilization. The three metrics may improve together or trade off; record the stage where each change acts.

Sources: [ROCS: Request-Oriented Compute Sharing for Efficient Large-Scale Recommendation](../../../../reproductions/2607.27744-rocs/README-en.md) · [Rec-Distill: An Industrial Distillation Pipeline for Large-Scale Recommendation Models](../../../../reproductions/2605.29755-rec-distill/README-en.md) · [Optimizing Effective Training Time for Large-Scale Recommendation Systems](../../../../reproductions/2610.02057-effective-training-time/README-en.md)

### Automated research must be able to choose no change

FORTE puts cost-saving proposals through quality and lineage gates. Retaining the original model when no candidate passes is a valid result. The Self-Evolving RecSys outer state machine also cannot treat completion of an inner experiment as production readiness. ETT reminds us to count failure recovery and duplicate work. Long-term memory should retain failure reasons, budgets, and consumer constraints, not merely names of successful proposals.

Sources: [FORTE: A Production Framework for Feature Evaluation and Deprecation in Industrial Recommender Systems](../../../../reproductions/2610.13806-forte/README-en.md) · [Self-Evolving Recommendation System: End-To-End Autonomous Model Optimization With LLM Agents](../../../../reproductions/2602.10226-self-evolving-rec/README-en.md) · [Optimizing Effective Training Time for Large-Scale Recommendation Systems](../../../../reproductions/2610.02057-effective-training-time/README-en.md)

## Cross-paper questions {#questions}

Try answering before expanding the explanation. Each question relates at least two papers.

### ROCS and Rec-Distill both lower online cost. Why not add their savings directly? {#cross-sharing-versus-distillation}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** ROCS eliminates repeated shareable encoding within a request. Rec-Distill changes the deployed model and leaves teacher and auxiliary work in training. The distilled architecture may change the shareable fraction, while kernels and bandwidth affect latency. Measure the combined path instead of multiplying or adding independent speedups.

    **Illustrative example:** A student with much lighter user encoding may leave less duplication for ROCS to remove. Extra teacher training does not appear in per-request latency.

    Sources: [ROCS: Request-Oriented Compute Sharing for Efficient Large-Scale Recommendation](../../../../reproductions/2607.27744-rocs/README-en.md) · [Rec-Distill: An Industrial Distillation Pipeline for Large-Scale Recommendation Models](../../../../reproductions/2605.29755-rec-distill/README-en.md)

### Why might Effective Training Time be low even when the GPU stays busy and ROCS speeds up requests? {#cross-effective-time-versus-busy-time}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** ETT counts only training time consuming new data in the numerator. Its denominator includes setup, compilation, checkpointing, publishing, and recovery. GPUs can be busy in those phases, and ROCS targets online inference rather than training. Attribute losses by phase and owner, not device busy time or inference latency.

    **Illustrative example:** If 8 of 10 wall-clock hours train on new data and 2 compile or recover, ETT is 80% even if the GPU is fully occupied for the remaining 2 hours.

    Sources: [Optimizing Effective Training Time for Large-Scale Recommendation Systems](../../../../reproductions/2610.02057-effective-training-time/README-en.md) · [ROCS: Request-Oriented Compute Sharing for Efficient Large-Scale Recommendation](../../../../reproductions/2607.27744-rocs/README-en.md)

### If two features show almost no loss under separate FORTE perturbations, why can't a research agent delete both? {#cross-joint-removal-needs-new-evidence}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** The features may back each other up; deleting one leaves the other signal, while deleting both exposes non-additive loss. FORTE also requires joint ablation, retraining, and an audit of all consumers. Send the proposal through actual Self-Evolving RecSys gates and retain failures in the journal instead of inferring safety from single-feature tests.

    **Illustrative example:** A brand ID and a brand word can both identify the brand. Deleting either may barely matter, while deleting both hurts a sparse task. This is illustrative, not a paper measurement.

    Sources: [FORTE: A Production Framework for Feature Evaluation and Deprecation in Industrial Recommender Systems](../../../../reproductions/2610.13806-forte/README-en.md) · [Self-Evolving Recommendation System: End-To-End Autonomous Model Optimization With LLM Agents](../../../../reproductions/2602.10226-self-evolving-rec/README-en.md)

### If a Rec-Distill student scores slightly better offline and a research agent journals it, has it completed the launch loop? {#cross-research-memory-is-not-promotion}

??? note "Show answer and example"

    **Answer:** No. Check student sampling correction, main and auxiliary roles, and matched budgets so the gain is not a protocol change. Then require independent validation and applicable online gates under the Self-Evolving RecSys outer controls. A journal preserves auditable runs and conclusions but does not grant promotion or replace execution evidence.

    **Illustrative example:** If AUC changes after adjusting the student's negative sampling rate, repair any mismatch with the teacher logits' probability space before comparing. A “distillation succeeded” entry cannot fix it.

    Sources: [Rec-Distill: An Industrial Distillation Pipeline for Large-Scale Recommendation Models](../../../../reproductions/2605.29755-rec-distill/README-en.md) · [Self-Evolving Recommendation System: End-To-End Autonomous Model Optimization With LLM Agents](../../../../reproductions/2602.10226-self-evolving-rec/README-en.md)
